metadata.description: Meta-installer + 18 skills across design, code quality, and ops. Scans a repo and recommends the matching skill bundle.

plugins.name: dev-stack-installer
plugins.description: One skill scans your repo, detects the stack (frontend/backend/mobile/infra/data/product), and recommends the matching bundle of 18 skills: design (figma-handoff, tokens, ui-audit, component-doc), code quality (rust-clippy-strict, python-typing-uplift, ts-strict-migrate, sql-review, api-contract-check, dep-audit, test-gap-finder, env-vars-audit, readme-doctor, perf-budget), and ops (docker-slim, github-actions-audit, migration-writer).
